results.title: Venues – IJCAI 2026
excerpts: The main IJCAI-ECAI 2026 conference will take place from 18 to 21 August 2026 at the Congress Centrum Bremen ( https://congress-bremen.com/en/ ) (CCB), a centrally located congress venue in the heart of Bremen. Inside, the congress building offers postmodern conference spaces with generous natural light for plenary talks, technical sessions and networking opportunities. Directly connected to the CCB, Hall 4 will serve as the main area for the exhibition, poster sessions and coffee breaks, creating a central meeting point for participants throughout the conference. The workshops and tutorials of IJCAI-ECAI 2026 will take place from 15 to 17 August 2026 on the campus of the University of Bremen ( https://www.uni-bremen.de/en/ ), before the main conference. As AI continues to transform industries, academia, and society at large, staying informed about the latest trends has never been more crucial. We invite submissions for the 35th International Joint Conference on Artificial Intelligence IJCAI-ECAI 2026, scheduled to take place in Bremen, Germany, from August 15 to 21, 2026. Since its founding in 1969, IJCAI has been the premier conference for the global AI community, fostering the exchange of groundbreaking advancements and achievements in AI research. This year, it once again is organised jointly with the European Artificial Intelligence Association as IJCAI-ECAI 2026. Home
